modes.purpose: NCCAOM study, clinic preparation, bilingual notes, and personal knowledge graph building.
modes.display_rule: Show Chinese and English terminology together. Chinese sources may guide structure and Chinese notes.

modes.purpose: Future clinic-facing or public education website.
allowed_source_types: professional English acupuncture texts when permission-safe
restricted_source_types: Chinese web articles as direct public citations
modes.display_rule: Show English-only content, use English/official/peer-reviewed sources, and keep Chinese web sources out of public-facing citations unless rewritten and independently verified.

visual_policy: Do not embed self-made or imprecise acupoint images. Prefer external source links until reviewed atlas assets exist.
mobile_policy: All directory, article, and charting views must collapse to one-column mobile layouts.
